entry.title: New: Bill 184 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 22, ARTICLE 2 AND ARTICLE 3, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO THE USE OF COUNTY STREETS; AND ESTABLISHES A SPECIAL ACTIVITY PERMIT FOR COMMERCIAL ACTIVITIES

Establishes a process to obtain a special permit and regulations to conduct temporary commercial activity on a County street, and increases fees from $25 to $50 for any permit issued for the lawful use of County streets.

Latest action: Council: Bill 184, Draft 3 passes second & final reading - 10/16/2024
